profile.headline: A full-time Software Engineer
profile.summary: A Computer Science graduate from the University of San Francisco.  I am skilled and interested in Backend development and learning more about Data Visualization.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
Contribute to continuous improvement and suggest improvements to the software and deployment architecture 
Participate in DevOps activities to maintain the Azure instances

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description: Assisting students in their labs/projects or helping understand specific CS concepts by providing weekly tutoring hours

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Implemented/researched new features for a Data Visualization project alongside a CS Faculty 
Attended weekly meetings to discuss new features to implement and report bugs/errors
Used Android Studio to build the mobile app allowing the implementation of the MPAndroidChart library to 
design and display graphs based on real-life datasets
• Featured implementations: sorting button, stacked-bar histogram, mini-view, and outlier detection

positions.title: Teaching Assistant for Data Structure and Algorithm
positions.description:
Inputting graded coursework by analyzing and running submitted assignments or projects. 
Assisting the teacher in daily class operations and student's issues.
Providing weekly office hours to assist student in their assignments or answering questions they have.
